# Shirdi Sai Mandir

> Shirdi Sai Mandir is a temple located at 24770 Evergreen Mills Rd in Sterling, Virginia. It serves the local community with the tagline 'Om Sai Ram'.

## Location & Contact
- Address: 24770 Evergreen Mills Rd, Sterling, VA 20166, United States
- Phone: +17036614724
